rounds.text: Akiko Global Services Ltd demonstrates exceptional fundamental strength, evidenced by a 5-year compounded profit growth of 118% [E17] and a TTM sales growth of 93% [E16]. The company operates with superior capital efficiency, generating an ROE of 25.55% and an ROCE of 31.42% against sector benchmarks of 11.94% and 16.58% respectively [E9, E10]. Valuation models point to a substantial mispricing, as a discounted cash flow analysis estimates intrinsic value at ₹606 per share, providing a 41.9% margin of safety against the current market price of ₹352 [E39, E40]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF indicates that the market price currently prices in only 10.5% earnings growth, well below the 18.0% base case assumption [E41]. Momentum is powerfully backed by fundamentals, reflected in a rules-based screen score of 99 out of 100 alongside strong institutional money flow [E38, E58]. Conceded: operating cash flow turned negative at Rs -2 Cr in Mar 2026, and borrowings increased to Rs 14 Cr [E29, E33].
